Metadata.description: A digital workspace portal: reach the apps you have access to, and request the ones you don't.

SignIn.title: Welcome to {name}
SignIn.firstTimeBody: Use the invite link you were sent.

Home.greeting: {name, select, __none {Hi there.} other {Hi {name}.}} What would you like to do?

Tour.offer: New here? A quick look around takes a minute.
Tour.yourAppsBody: Everything you can open is here. Click one to go straight in.
Tour.allAppsBody: See everything there is, by what it’s for, and ask for what you don’t have yet. An admin lets you in.
Tour.welcomeBody: A few things to do first. They tick themselves off, and the list goes once they’re done.
Tour.accountBody: Sign out here when you’re done, and change the language next to it.

Media.heading: New on {app}
Media.unavailableDetail: It’s usually brief, and the rest of the page still works.

Welcome.heading: Getting started
Welcome.passkeyBody: If you lose this device, a second passkey (on your phone, say) still lets you in.
Welcome.prerequisiteBody: {count, plural, one {{apps} only works with it.} other {{apps} only work with it.}}
Welcome.requestTitle: Ask for an app you need
Welcome.requestBody: See what’s available and ask. An admin lets you in.
Welcome.tourBody: A short tour of where things are.

YourApps.heading: Your apps
YourApps.loadError: We couldn’t load your apps just now.
YourApps.loadErrorDetail: It’s usually brief. Your apps themselves still work.
YourApps.seeAllOrAsk: See all apps, or ask for more
YourApps.emptyTitle: You don’t have any apps yet.
YourApps.emptyAskBody: See what’s available, and ask for what you need. An admin lets you in.
YourApps.emptyAskAdmin: Ask an administrator to give you access.

Apps.title: Apps
Apps.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, or by what it’s for
Apps.found: {count, plural, one {# app found.} other {# apps found.}}
Apps.usableEmptyAsk: Nothing yet. Ask for something below, and it shows up here once an admin lets you in.
Apps.usableEmptyAdmin: You don’t have access to any apps yet. Ask an administrator.
Apps.noGroup: No group grants access to this app yet.
Apps.statusPending: {group, select, __none {Waiting for an admin} other {{group}: waiting for an admin}}
Apps.statusSettling: {group, select, __none {Approved — ready in a few minutes} other {{group}: approved — ready in a few minutes}}
Apps.needsMissing: Needs {names} to work, which you don’t have yet.

AskForm.reasonPlaceholder: The admin sees this when they decide.
AskForm.already_active: You’ve already asked for this role. Reload the page to see where it stands.
AskForm.already_granted: You already have this role. Reload the page to see it.
AskForm.not_allowed: That role can’t be requested for this app any more. Reload the page to see what’s available.
AskForm.message_too_long: Keep your reason to {max} characters or fewer.
AskForm.reason_required: Add a reason, so the admin knows why you need it.
AskForm.requests_disabled: Access requests aren’t being taken at the moment. Reload the page.
AskForm.rate_limited: You’ve sent a lot of requests in the last hour. Try again later.

AdminNews.title: News
AdminNews.none: No posts yet. A post shows on everyone’s dashboard, or only for the groups you choose.
AdminNews.bodyHint: Plain text. A blank line starts a paragraph. Also: # heading, - list, **bold**, *italic*, [link text](https://…).
AdminNews.audienceHint: Nobody ticked: everyone. Otherwise only people in the groups you tick.
AdminNews.problemBadDate: That “shown until” date isn’t a date.
AdminNews.problemUnknownGroup: One of those groups isn’t in PocketID any more.
AdminNews.picturesHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB. Where and with what a photo was taken is removed before it’s kept. Only people who can read the post see its pictures.
AdminNews.pictureInPost: To show it in the post, add this line:
AdminNews.problemNotAnImage: That isn’t a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF picture.

AdminIntegrations.title: Integrations
AdminIntegrations.jellyfinHint: Shows what’s new on Jellyfin on the dashboard of people who can open it.
AdminIntegrations.keyMissing: API key: not set. Create one in Jellyfin (Dashboard → API Keys) and give it to the portal as JELLYFIN_API_KEY (or JELLYFIN_API_KEY_FILE); until then nothing shows.
AdminIntegrations.linkedLabel: Shown to people who can open
AdminIntegrations.linkedHint: Usually Jellyfin’s own app in PocketID.
AdminIntegrations.problemBadUrl: Give an address that starts with https:// or http://, with no password in it.
AdminIntegrations.problemUnknownApp: That app isn’t in PocketID any more.

AdminApps.title: App catalog
AdminApps.heading: Apps
AdminApps.emptyNone: PocketID has no OIDC clients yet. Add one there and it appears here.
AdminApps.fixHeading: {count, plural, one {# app needs} other {# apps need}} something from PocketID
AdminApps.fixBoth: {app} has no link to open it and doesn’t say what it’s for.
AdminApps.fixNoLink: {app} has no link to open it, so it can’t be on the Apps page.
AdminApps.fixNoDescription: {app} doesn’t say what it’s for, so people only see its name.
AdminApps.stateNoLink: On, but has no link yet

AdminApp.title: Edit app
AdminApp.stateListed: Shown. Everyone signed in sees it, and can ask for it.
AdminApp.stateNoLink: On, but it has no link yet, so it isn’t shown.
AdminApp.stateHidden: Hidden. Nobody sees it, and nobody can ask for it.
AdminApp.categoryHint: Pick one, or type a new one. Leave it empty for “Other”.
AdminApp.missingDescription: Missing. Add a description in PocketID that says what it’s for, like “Watch films and series”. Until then people only see its name.
AdminApp.missingLink: Missing. Add a launch link (http or https) in PocketID. Without one it can’t be opened from here, so it stays off the Apps page.
AdminApp.previewOff: Not on the Apps page right now.
AdminApp.needsHint: For an app that only works with another one, like a dashboard behind the VPN. People see it on the Apps page. The portal doesn’t check it.
AdminApp.needsNothing: Nothing else. It works on its own.
AdminApp.needsNoCandidates: No other app can be added: the rest already need one themselves.
AdminApp.neededBy: {count, plural, one {{names} needs} other {{names} need}} this app, so it can’t need another one itself.
AdminApp.refusedPrerequisiteNeedsAnother: That app needs another one itself, so it can’t be needed here.
AdminApp.refusedAppIsAPrerequisite: Other apps need this one, so it can’t need another app itself.
AdminApp.refusedUnknownApp: That app isn’t in PocketID any more.

AdminRequests.title: Requests
AdminRequests.waiting: {count, plural, =0 {You’re all caught up} one {1 person is waiting} other {# people are waiting}}
AdminRequests.switchedOff: New requests are switched off (FEATURE_ACCESS_REQUESTS). You can still decide these.
AdminRequests.caughtUpDetail: New requests show up here, and as a number on Requests in the menu.
AdminRequests.cantApprove: Can’t be approved: the app is hidden, or this group was removed from it in PocketID.
AdminRequests.notGrantable: This group can’t be granted for this app any more: the app is hidden, or the group was removed from it in PocketID. Decline the request instead.
AdminRequests.askedTogether: Asked together with {app}, which needs it.

AdminAudit.title: History
AdminAudit.noMatch: Nothing like that in the history yet.

SecretsBanner.label: Security warning
SecretsBanner.lead: PocketID exposes its SMTP/LDAP passwords to this portal’s API key.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: That URL doesn’t match anything in this workspace. It may have been an app link that changed, or a page you don’t have access to.

AuthError.title: Sign-in problem
AuthError.heading: Sign-in didn’t work
AuthError.Configuration: There's a problem with the portal's setup, so it couldn't sign you in. If you run this portal, its logs say what went wrong.
AuthError.AccessDenied: PocketID didn't let you sign in to this portal. Ask an admin if you think you should have access.
AuthError.Verification: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Start again from the sign-in page.
AuthError.fallback: Something went wrong while signing you in. Try again from the sign-in page.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.body: That action didn’t complete. Nothing was changed if it failed partway — you can try again, or head back and start over.
Error.globalBody: The portal couldn’t load. This usually means it can’t reach PocketID — trying again in a moment is the fastest fix.

Email.newAlsoAsks: They also asked for {names}, which it needs.
Email.approvedBody: Your request for {group} was approved. It can take a few minutes to show up in the portal.
Email.deniedBody: Your request for {group} was denied. You can request it again with more detail.
